Shred layout, type constants, parsing, and helper functions for Solana block data.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_shred` data format used to store and parse Solana shred packets in Firedancer. It declares the packed `fd_shred_t` structure, size limits, type values, flag masks, and error codes needed to read data shreds and coding shreds, including legacy, Merkle, chained, and resigned variants. The file also provides inline helper functions to extract the shred type, compute header and payload sizes, locate Merkle proof data, and identify chained or resigned shreds. It declares the main parse and Merkle root reconstruction functions that validate untrusted shred bytes and support proof handling.
